From Just Visiting: 2–4 and 6–9 are p1 unimproved pinks/oranges or p4’s Electric/Penn RR ($100 with 3 railroads). Only 5 (Virginia), 11 (Kentucky), and 12 (Chance) are useful, and 5 is the only high-value buy in one roll. Paying $50 to roll into that strip is −EV. p3’s Boardwalk is already 2 houses ($600); $863 covers it once, $813 still does, but I do not need to spend to walk into $100 railroad rent. If I miss, I stay off rents while p1 is also jailed and p4 is the only one circulating — annoying, but better than paying to land on their railroads. Revisit paying on turn 2 if doubles fail and the open colors are still up."}
